eight_expert.note: Eight experts, three protected tasks, seven complete test datasets; TA coefficient 0.2. AGA processes only the protected expert. EuroSAT is excluded; no eight-task mean. Partner losses remain in the table.

attacks.note: Two experts, TA coefficient 0.5. TA uses no recovery; AGA processes the protected expert. Calib. uses 64 fixed random images for output calibration. MLP matching uses public weights. Distillation additionally uses unlabeled training images and student training. Defense 1 and PaRaMS share the unprotected student because their teacher labels coincide. Higher standalone accuracy and lower merged accuracy favor protection.

partners.note: Two experts, TA coefficient 0.5. TA uses no recovery; AGA processes the protected expert. Calib. uses 64 fixed random images for output calibration. MLP matching uses public weights. Distillation additionally uses unlabeled training images and student training. Defense 1 and PaRaMS share the unprotected student because their teacher labels coincide. These are partner accuracies, not protection scores.
